name: Parallelization for Backpropagation
definition: An alternative parallelization strategy for efficient backpropagation that changes the approach from per-pixel to per-splat to address training speed obstacles.
summary: Parallelization for Backpropagation, or Per-splat Backpropagation, accelerates 3D Gaussian Splatting training by computing gradients per Gaussian instead of per pixel, eliminating atomic contention and reducing training time by 4–5×.
